description: This file defines the WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragment class, which manages a UI fragment for switching to a different keyboard input method within the app's setup wizard. It handles user interactions such as showing the input method picker and skipping the setup wizard, and updates UI elements based on the current setup state.

classes.name: WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that provides UI for switching to a different keyboard input method during setup, including handling user interactions and updating UI state.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for this wizard page.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets up click listeners for user interactions.

methods.name: refreshFragmentUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on the current setup state.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the current keyboard is set as the default IME.
